title: Go na le molelo mo Thabeng
description: Thuli le ditsala tsa gagwe ba rata go tshameka ”Gona le molelo mo Thabeng“. Fela letsatsi lengwe ga nna le molelo wa nnete mme dijalo tsotlhe tse dintle tsa fetoga molora. Thuli le ditsala tsa gagwe ba hutsafetse … go fitlha ba bona dikumutwana dingwe tse dikhibidu le tse ditala. E ka nna eng?
subjects: Nature and looking after our planet
